personality_one_liner: A warm, grounded, and emotionally safe space that feels like a trusted personal notebook rather than cold software.

spacing.rule: Generous, breathable paper-like margins. Avoid dense nesting. Soft, imperfect gaps rather than strict operational grids.

dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism as it clashes with the matte, tactile paper aesthetic.

screens.name: Onboarding / Auth
screens.purpose: A calm, conversational entry asking the user about their manifestation goals.

states.error: Muted terracotta error text with a retry button

screens.layout: Full-bleed soft background images with a bottom sheet for form inputs. Sticky bottom CTA for 'Continue'. Inputs should have subtle bottom borders or soft rounded tertiary backgrounds rather than hard boxes.

screens.name: Home (Today)
screens.purpose: Focus the user on a single daily affirmation, streak, and quick access to their core manifestation acts.

states.loading: Skeleton of the daily affirmation card with soft shimmer
states.empty: A soft sketch-like illustration prompting them to set their first intention

screens.layout: Header with user greeting and streak counter. Below, a large, beautiful Affirmation Card dominating the screen (using the morning sunlight image + scrim). Below that, a simple quick-action grid or list for Journal, Vision Board, and Visualization.

screens.name: Journal & Vision Board
screens.purpose: A tactile, scrapbooking space for intentions and visual goals.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of an open notebook with 'Add your first vision' CTA
states.error: Failed to load board, tap to retry

screens.layout: Top toggle (Segmented control) between 'Journal' and 'Vision Board'. Journal: simple list of dated cards. Vision Board: a relaxed 2-col masonry or asymmetrical grid of photos with small, handwritten-like captions. Generous spacing so it feels like pinned polaroids.

screens.name: AI Manifestation Coach
screens.purpose: A safe, supportive chat interface with 'Hera'.

states.empty: Hera's avatar with introductory prompt chips

screens.layout: Conversational UI. User messages in brandTertiary, AI messages in surfaceSecondary. KeyboardAvoidingView with a soft input field. No sharp chat bubbles; use rounded lg radii. Include quick-reply chips above the input.

screens.name: Discover
screens.purpose: Articles, quotes, and guided sessions laid out beautifully.
screens.layout: Horizontal scroll of category chips (brandTertiary). Below, large editorial cards for articles with background images, gradients, and white text over the scrim. Quiet humanist sans-serif for metadata.

screens.name: Guided Visualization (Player)
screens.layout: Full-screen abstract aura background. Large central timer or breathing circle. Minimal controls (play/pause/end) at the bottom. No heavy chrome.

screens.name: Profile & Premium Upsell
screens.purpose: Manage settings and subscribe to premium.
screens.layout: Top section: Profile info and stats. A 'Pro' card with the gold texture background, featuring premium benefits in a list. Settings rows below with brandTertiary-tinted icon containers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Hand-Drawn / Journal personality constraints. No harsh shadows (tier 0), no glassmorphism (keep it matte and tactile), and irregular/mixed radii where applicable.
BANNED: Any shade of blue, purple, indigo, or highly saturated bright colors. Stick to the warm off-white and sage/moss earthy tones.
Use Fraunces (serif) for display/headings for an editorial, grounded feel and Nunito (sans-serif) for body text to maintain softness.
Whenever text is placed over imagery (e.g., Affirmation Card, Premium Upsell), use a top-to-bottom three-stop linear gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to ensure AAA readability.

For the vision board, use a flexible grid layout (e.g., 2-column with space-between) allowing generous 'md' or 'lg' gaps to feel like polaroids pinned to a board. Use real fetched images from the design_guidelines.
All primary CTAs (e.g., Save Journal Entry, Subscribe to Premium) should be sticky at the bottom above the safe area, allowing content to scroll fully behind it.
Avoid gamified clutter; streak markers or mood trackers should use subtle terracotta or sage dots. Keep the UI serene, centered on wellbeing, with generous whitespace.
